headline: UCSB Pass Times Explained: Pass 1, 2, 3 & How to Prep
description: What UCSB pass times are, where to find yours in GOLD, how Pass 1, 2, and 3 work, and how to prep so registration takes minutes.

mainEntity.name: Where do I find my UCSB pass time?

acceptedAnswer.text: In GOLD, under the registration section — pass times are posted there before each quarter's registration opens, and each student's windows are assigned individually.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Pass 1, Pass 2, and Pass 3 at UCSB?

acceptedAnswer.text: Each pass is a registration window with a unit cap. Pass 1 is for must-have and fast-filling classes, Pass 2 completes a full schedule, and Pass 3 is for swaps and waitlist cleanup.

mainEntity.name: What should I do if a class is full at my pass time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Register a backup schedule so you hold real classes, join the waitlist if available, and watch the first week of the quarter as seats open when students drop.
